Target IaC language: Terraform (HCL .tf format)

Task: Create an IAM user named 'jenkins-deploy' for a CI/CD pipeline that needs to deploy AWS Lambda functions and update CloudFormation stacks.

Output only the Terraform (HCL .tf format) code, no commentary or markdown fences.

      "cloudformation:ListStackResources",
      "cloudformation:ListExports",
      "cloudformation:ListImports",
      "cloudformation:TagResource",
      "cloudformation:UntagResource"

    resources = ["*"]

  statement {
    sid     = "LambdaDeployment"

    sid     = "IamPassRoleRestrictedToServices"
    effect  = "Allow"

      "sts:GetCallerIdentity",
      "sts:GetSessionToken"

    resources = ["*"]
  }
}
